string-array.name: raw_location_disclosure_steps
string-array.item: Optional · Adults 18+. Adds future precise location observations, timestamps, accuracy and available altitude/speed to Supabase cloud sync.
These originals can reconstruct your route. Retained for 7 days from observation.
Your connected browser can read them in the developer map. They are not sent to Gemini.
Previously collected points are never uploaded. Approval does not start location collection.
Cloud sync off stops uploads. Server copies remain until deleted or expired.
Set Location recording to Always to collect a continuous trail.
